title: Attestation Evidence V1.0
description: Typed evidence for runtime trust decisions, classified using SET.

EvidenceItems.description: List of evidence items classified using the Security Evidence Taxonomy.

Type.description: Evidence type identifier from the Security Evidence Taxonomy.

Value.description: Opaque evidence payload encoded as base64url.

Verifier.description: ID of the component that produced or verified the evidence.

HashAlgorithm.description: Optional hash algorithm identifier from the Security Algorithm Taxonomy.

HashValue.description: Optional hash of the evidence payload (hex or base64url).

Signature.description: Hexadecimal ASCII-encoded signature over the canonical form (PTF-JSON-CANON-V1) of the object without its Signature, by the key KeyID names.

KeyID.description: Identifier of the key that verifies the Signature; the key's identity states its algorithm.
